spotter.title: Spotter
spotter.description: Spotter is a management app for personal trainers: it lets you upload exercises, track clients, and view their statistics. It uses SQL as the database and Supabase as the online database.

phyronChecker.title: Phyron Checker
phyronChecker.description: Phyron Checker is a lightweight utility that verifies, through HTTP HEAD requests, whether a dealership's vehicles are published on the Phyron platform. Built for integration into production projects at car dealerships, it allows quick monitoring of the publication status of listings without downloading unnecessary content.

audit.description: Audit is a Windows desktop application for downloading and converting media content. I developed the Electron main process with a Python worker for processing, bundling the Python and FFmpeg runtimes in the installation package, with no external dependencies.
